aboutText: Affordable Car Service Derrimut and 3Sixty Auto Group are specialist mechanics in the automotive industry, providing all types of vehicle repairs and servicing across Derrimut. Our qualified automotive mechanics have decades of experience covering general car servicing, log book service, and auto electrical repairs. We ensure every vehicle is serviced to manufacturer standards, maintaining your warranty and keeping you safe on Melbourne's roads.
servicesText: From routine log book servicing to complex auto electrical repairs, our qualified Derrimut mechanics handle all vehicle makes and models. With decades of experience, we provide comprehensive car servicing, brake and suspension work, and advanced engine diagnostics to keep you safe on Melbourne's western suburbs roads.
